items.title: Stablecoins Won't Scale Without Banks
items.summary: With a growing number of institutions exploring stablecoins, the bottleneck is regulated infrastructure they can trust.

items.title: This Crypto Project Just Funded 1,000 Student Loans Entirely On-Chain
items.summary: The team behind Pencil Finance says the financing supported thousands of Southeast Asian students, but it did not disclose borrower costs, defaults, or investor returns.

items.title: Ancient Bitcoin Wallet That Turned $120 Into $3 Million Wakes Up
items.summary: At least four more decade-old wallets moved a combined $15.7 million between Aug. 29 and Sept. 4, with one batch of coins sent to Coinbase in a likely sign of a sale.

items.title: What Is Robinhood Chain? The Ethereum Layer-2 Network for Tokenized Stocks and Meme Coins
items.summary: Robinhood Chain is an Ethereum layer-2 network built with Arbitrum technology for tokenized assets, crypto apps, and on-chain financial products.

items.title: Mexican National Pleads Guilty to Laundering More than $4M in Drug Trafficking Proceeds
items.summary: A Mexican national, Carlos Erick Vazquez Gonzalez, 48, pleaded guilty today for his role in the laundering of approximately $4 million in drug trafficking proceeds in the United States and the return of those proceeds via cryptocurrency to Mexico as part of a money laundering con

items.title: Justice Department Continues to Disrupt Hamas Terrorist Financing Schemes Through Seizures of Cryptocurrency and Internet Infrastructure
items.summary: Today the Justice Department announced the disruption of an ongoing scheme by Harakat al-Muqawama al-Islamiyya (Hamas) –— a designated Foreign Terrorist Organization — to raise funds for terrorist operations and recruit supporters.
